name: @bmg-esports/gjallarhorn
description: Bundle of stream tools for Brawlhalla tournaments

scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspaces && rimraf output temp
scripts.build:clean: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.generate-schema: mkdir -p tmp-schema && curl -o tmp-schema/schema.graphql https://publicapi.challengermode.com/graphql?sdl && graphql-schema-typescript generate-ts tmp-schema --output packages/core/src/@types/challengermode.d.ts && rm -rf tmp-schema
